# proxmox_node_ceph_osd (Resource)

Creates an OSD from a device through `POST /nodes/{node}/ceph/osd` and destroys it again. Import as `<node>/<osdid>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_osd" "d" {
  node = "pve-1"
  dev  = "/dev/sdb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dev` (String) Block device such as `/dev/sdb`.
- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Optional

- `cleanup_on_destroy` (Boolean) Wipe the device on destroy.
- `db_dev` (String) Dedicated DB device.
- `device_class` (String) CRUSH device class.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Encrypt the OSD.
- `osds_per_device` (Number) OSDs per device.
- `wal_dev` (String) Dedicated WAL device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<osdid>` form.
- `osdid` (Number) Numeric OSD id assigned by Ceph.
